map.换算统一走基准单位：体积以毫升为 1（升 1000、美制杯 236.588、英制: Conversions go through a base unit: volume uses millilitres as 1 (litre 1000, US cup 236.588, UK cup 284.131, Chinese cup 240, US tablespoon 14.7868, UK tablespoon 17.7582, tablespoon 15, US teaspoon 4.92892, UK teaspoon 5.91939, teaspoon 5, US gallon 3785.41, UK gallon 4546.09, US quart 946.353, etc.); weight uses grams as 1 (kilogram 1000, milligram 0.001, pound 453.592, ounce 28.3495, jin 500, liang 50, qian 5, Hong Kong liang 37.7994, Hong Kong jin 604.79, stone 6350.29). Result = input × source unit factor ÷ target unit factor; the result is cleared when the input is non-numeric or negative. Temperature: °F = °C × 9 ÷ 5 + 32, °C = (°F − 32) × 5 ÷ 9. Serving scale = target servings ÷ original servings; each line matching "number + unit + name" has its number multiplied by that scale, and a warning appears when servings are non-positive or non-numeric. Ingredient conversion: cups use grams per cup, tablespoons use grams per tablespoon, teaspoons use grams per teaspoon, millilitres are derived as grams per cup ÷ 240, and from grams: kilogram = g ÷ 1000, jin = g ÷ 500, liang = g ÷ 50, ounce = g ÷ 28.3495, pound = g ÷ 453.592
